import os
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687659/attempts/4b6740fb5c394cfaab2dd4985d9f6926/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def mirror_index(i, n):
        tile, offset = divmod(i, n)
        return offset if tile % 2 == 1 else n - 1 - offset
    return [[grid[mirror_index(i, h)][mirror_index(j, w)]
             for j in range(3 * w)] for i in range(3 * h)]
'''
p=base/'task-b1476ffe.py'
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
test=[[8,8,6],[6,3,6],[6,8,8]]
